Site 40 is largely excluded from higher-order epistasis in this landscape.

The inferred complete four-site landscape contains 30 local fitness maxima, of which 15 exceed wild-type fitness, and the basins of attraction of those 15 peaks cover 99% of sequence space.

Adaptation in this landscape is dominated by 'conversion' steps that change the amino acid at an already-mutated site (17%, 41% and 59% of mutational steps under the greedy, correlated-fixation and eq
Many adaptive paths in this landscape require more than four mutational steps, which is the maximum length of a direct path between any two variants in a four-site space.
Allowing indirect paths raises the fraction of genotypes with an accessible path to all 15 above-wild-type peaks from 34% to 93%.
Ruggedness induced by pairwise epistasis correlates positively with the number of selectively inaccessible direct paths (Pearson correlation 0.66 across 29 subgraphs).
10,639 variants (6.6% of the four-site space) had fewer than 10 sequencing reads in the input library and their fitness values were imputed rather than measured.
